kits.name: Annotate
kits.description: Circle what is wrong on a capture, write a word beside it, and the agent that asked receives the annotated image and your notes.
kits.permissionsSummary: Reads an image of the workspace, writes the annotated PNG and a JSON of the notes to .hangar/annotations/, and tells the agent that asked where they are.

kits.name: Checklist
kits.description: A tab where a person works through a list of manual checks an agent wrote, and the agent gets the result back to fix what failed.
kits.permissionsSummary: Reads the checklist file an agent wrote in the workspace, keeps your answers in the kit's own data folder, and sends the agent that asked a plain summary of the results. Changes no project file.

kits.name: CI status
kits.description: A tab that follows a GitHub Actions run, opened by itself after a git push.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs the GitHub CLI (gh run list, gh run view) to read CI runs, shows a tab and sends notifications, and runs a hook after git push to open that tab.

kits.name: Database
kits.description: Opens a SQLite database of the project read-only: its tables with their counts, a table's structure and rows with sort and paging. Values stay on screen unless you hand the table and a question to an agent.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs four declared commands, a Node script that opens a SQLite file of the workspace read-only (no SQL of your own) to list databases, tables, a structure and rows; keeps your last choice in the kit's data folder; sends a table and your question, never its rows, to an agent only when you click.

kits.name: Dependencies
kits.description: Lists the vulnerable and out-of-date packages of the project from its lockfile, when you ask, and hands any of them to an agent. Agents read the last audit instead of running it again.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs one declared command, a Node script that calls your package manager's read-only audit and outdated commands (pnpm, npm, yarn, cargo, pip) when you click; keeps the last result in the kit's own data folder; and sends a package to an agent of the workspace only when you click.

kits.name: Editor
kits.description: Opens a .env or a config file in a tab for you to fill in or check, so that an agent that needs a secret goes on without ever seeing it.
kits.permissionsSummary: Reads and changes text files of the workspace, .env and other hidden files included, and tells the agent that asked which keys were set, never their values.

kits.name: GitHub
kits.description: The open pull requests and issues of the repository, with their checks and reviews, each handed to an agent in one click.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs the GitHub CLI read-only (gh repo view, gh pr list and view, gh issue list and view, gh api graphql with a fixed query for review threads), shows two tabs, sends a brief to an agent of the workspace when you ask, and keeps its filters in the kit's own data folder. Nothing is written to GitHub.

kits.name: Guardrails
kits.description: Refuses dangerous commands and the reading of secrets before they run. You let one through once, in a click, from its tab.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs a hook before each call of a tool that runs a command or touches a file (Bash, PowerShell, Monitor, Read, Edit, Write, Grep and the others its README lists) that can refuse it, shows a tab listing the refusals, and keeps them with its one-time passes in the kit's own data folder.

kits.name: Services
kits.description: What is running on this computer, on which port, and whose it is: listening ports and Docker containers, tied to the worker whose port block they sit in, without a terminal.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs three read-only commands (a small Node script that lists listening ports, docker ps and docker logs), reads the workspace's panels to name a port's worker, and sends a message to a panel only when you ask an agent to stop something. It stops nothing itself.

kits.name: Tests
kits.description: Shows whether the tests pass without reading a terminal, and hands a failure to an agent in one click. Agents read the last result instead of running everything again.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs a hook after each Bash and PowerShell call that reads the output of a test run and keeps its result in the kit's own data folder; a tab reads it and, when you click, sends a failure to an agent of the workspace.

kits.name: TODO
kits.description: Lists the TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments of the project, grouped by file or by tag, and hands any of them to an agent in one click.
kits.permissionsSummary: Runs one declared command, a Node script that only reads the workspace's files .gitignore leaves in (and `git blame` on one file when you ask); opens a file in the preview when you click; keeps the last scan in the kit's data folder; sends a comment to an agent only when you click.
